name: @jexs/client
description: Browser runtime for Jexs — DOM, fetch, audio, WebSocket, push, and WebRTC nodes

scripts.build:browser: node -e "require('fs').rmSync('dist/browser',{recursive:true,force:true})" && esbuild client=src/index.ts sw=src/sw.ts physicsWorker=src/physicsWorker.ts resolverWorker=src/resolverWorker.ts --bundle --format=esm --splitting --outdir=dist/browser --entry-names=[name] --chunk-names=chunks/[hash] --minify --target=es2022
